changes: Android/phone: stream info with declared FPS/bitrate, MIME codecs, channels and sample rate when available.
Android/phone: selected track labels, preferred audio/subtitle language, SRT/VTT/ASS file selection for IPTV VOD and episodes, subtitle size/color/position, available source video quality.
Samsung: AVPlay audio/text track selection, subtitle off and stream info; remote-friendly in-player dialogs.
LG: native HTML audio/text tracks where exposed, resolution and buffered ahead; explicit unavailable metadata.
limitations: No claim of universal codec or four-stream compatibility.
FPS and bitrate are declared stream metadata, not measured render/network rates.
Subtitle delay and phone-to-TV subtitle upload are not implemented in this release.
External subtitle files and detailed styling are Android/phone Media3 features; LG/Samsung depend on system track support.
